newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler unveils new ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler unveils new ad campaign.

text.p: Chrysler Corp announced Wednesday the company and its dealers will spend a combined $2 billion on advertising for the 1997 model year.
Included in that total will be a new corporate advertising campaign with the theme "Great Cars," which will emphasize the company's design and engineering capabilities.
Chrysler is also launching a new advertising campaign for the Chrysler brand under the slogan "What's new in your world?" that seeks to promote the product line as youthful and forward-looking.
The ads were unveiled at a meeting of Chrysler and its dealers here.

Chrysler told dealers that advertising in most markets will emphasize the Neon Expresso package, which will include the more powerful dual overhead cam engine, at a price of $12,770, up $300 from the Neon Highline model.
Other ads shown to dealers included a lease rate of $299 a month for the 1997 Sebring convertible, and a $359 a month lease rate for the 1997 LHS sedan. Other terms of the leases were not disclosed.
